news.headline: Assenagon Asset Management S.A. Has $23.65 Million Position in uniQure N.V.
news.summary: Assenagon Asset Management disclosed a $23.65 million position in uniQure after buying an additional 366,781 shares, lifting its stake to roughly 0.81% of shares outstanding. The filing points to growing institutional interest in QURE ahead of its planned AMT-130 regulatory filings.

news.headline: uniQure (NASDAQ:QURE) Lowered to "Sell" Rating by Wall Street Zen
news.summary: Wall Street Zen downgraded uniQure from Hold to Sell, citing lingering regulatory uncertainty around AMT-130 despite the FDA's June alignment on an accelerated-approval pathway. The downgrade stood out against a wave of bullish price-target hikes from other analysts following Q2 earnings.

news.headline: uniQure (NASDAQ:QURE) Price Target Raised to $75.00 at Wells Fargo & Company
news.summary: Wells Fargo raised its price target on uniQure to $75 from $60 while keeping an Overweight rating, citing encouraging early AMT-260 epilepsy data and a clearer AMT-130 regulatory path. The move followed uniQure's Q2 2026 earnings update two days earlier.

news.headline: Wolfe Research Upgrades uniQure to Outperform, Announces $65 Price Target
news.summary: Wolfe Research upgraded uniQure to Outperform from Peer Perform with a $65 price target, estimating roughly a 70% probability of AMT-130 approval and peak U.S. sales near $2 billion. Analyst Rudy Li cited a now-clearer path to accelerated approval for the Huntington's disease gene therapy.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reported Q2 2026 revenue of $5.8 million and a net loss of $81.1 million, with cash and investments of $810.3 million providing runway into 2030 following its June $259 million share offering. The company confirmed its U.S. BLA and U.K. MAA filings for AMT-130 remain on track for Q3 2026, with four-year topline data expected in September and early AMT-260 epilepsy data also disclosed.

news.headline: JPMorgan Chase & Co. Discloses 7.0% Passive Stake in uniQure N.V.
news.summary: A Schedule 13G filing showed JPMorgan Chase & Co. holding 4,866,211 uniQure ordinary shares, a 7.0% passive stake, as of mid-July 2026. The disclosure adds to a build-up of institutional ownership in QURE ahead of its pivotal AMT-130 regulatory catalysts.

catalysts.label: BLA submission for AMT-130 (U.S., accelerated approval)
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Biologics License Application to the FDA for accelerated approval of AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, based on 3-year Phase I/II data, after the FDA aligned this basis was reasonable.

catalysts.label: UK MAA submission for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Marketing Authorization Application to the UK's MHRA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease following a successful pre-submission meeting.

catalysts.label: Four-year AMT-130 topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline four-year data from the Phase I/II study of AMT-130 in Huntington's disease is expected, adding durability evidence ahead of and alongside the BLA filing.

catalysts.label: FDA agreement on confirmatory study design
catalysts.detail: uniQure and the FDA still need to finalize the design (including the control arm) of the required post-approval confirmatory study before the BLA is formally submitted.

catalysts.label: Updated AMT-260 (epilepsy) and AMT-191 (Fabry) data
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to present updated clinical data from its refractory epilepsy and Fabry disease gene therapy programs in the first half of 2027.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: uniQure is expected to report Q3 2026 financial results and provide a further pipeline and regulatory update, typically in early-to-mid November.

pulse: uniQure enters the second half of 2026 riding a major regulatory turnaround: after an FDA rebuff earlier in the year, the agency aligned in June that 3-year Phase I/II data can support an accelerated-approval BLA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, and the July 29 Q2 update reaffirmed that both the U.S. BLA and U.K. MAA filings remain on track for Q3 2026, with four-year topline data due in September. A $259 million June offering pushed cash to $810.3 million (runway into 2030), and sell-side sentiment has turned decisively bullish (Wolfe and Wells Fargo lifting targets to $65-$75) even as one contrarian Sell-rating (Wall Street Zen) flags lingering uncertainty over the still-unresolved confirmatory-study design. The stock, trading in the mid-$40s in August and up sharply over the past year, remains highly event-driven heading into the BLA submission and the September data readout.
